_comment: The installer writes these into ~/.claude/settings.json → env. Shown here for reference; you normally set VAULT_PATH when running install.sh, not by editing this file.

_notes.VAULT_PATH: Absolute path to the vault folder. This is what syncs across devices.
_notes.VAULT_WORKSPACE: The root you work under. Sessions anywhere below it are auto-captured; sessions outside it are ignored. Defaults to the vault's parent folder.
_notes.EXCLUDE_DIRS: Optional. Edit hooks/vault_capture.py to sandbox folders (relative to VAULT_WORKSPACE) whose sessions should never be captured, e.g. ["secrets", "client-x"]. Empty by default — capture everything.
